import_guide_csv_description: Upload your CSV file and let Trakt organize your movie and TV show universe. Make sure your CSV is properly formatted with the fields described in the guidelines.
import_guide_csv_intro: Your CSV file should contain a header row followed by one row per item to import.
import_guide_csv_title: Data in a grid? We've got you covered!
import_guide_field_id_description: The ID can be a Trakt ID, IMDB ID, or TMDB ID. For TV shows it can also be a TVDB ID.
import_guide_field_rated_at_description: Date and time the item was rated. ISO 8601 format.
import_guide_field_rated_at_note: Only parsed if a rating is also present.
import_guide_field_rating_description: Rating for the item. Must be a value from 1 to 10.
import_guide_field_type_description: Specifies what the ID refers to. Optional but recommended.
import_guide_field_watched_at_descriptio: Date and time the item was watched. ISO 8601 format.
import_guide_field_watched_at_note: Can be "unknown" to import with an unknown watch date. Omit if only adding to watchlist.
import_guide_field_watchlisted_at_descri: Date and time the item was added to your watchlist. ISO 8601 format.
import_guide_field_watchlisted_at_note: Omit if only marking as watched.

import_guide_json_description: Trakt welcomes your structured data with open arms. Upload your JSON file, making sure it follows our guidelines for a smooth and successful import.
import_guide_json_intro: Your JSON file should contain an array of objects. Each object represents an item to import.
import_guide_letterboxd_description: It's just a hop, skip, and a .zip away! Download your Letterboxd data and import it here. Here's the lowdown on getting that .zip:
import_guide_letterboxd_step_3: Download your Letterboxd export data in a zip file and upload it here
import_guide_letterboxd_title: Bring your Letterboxd diary to Trakt! 🎬
import_guide_tvtime_description: Here's how to bring your TV Time data into Trakt:
import_guide_tvtime_step_1: If you saved your TV Time data export before the service shut down, you can still bring it to Trakt.
import_guide_tvtime_step_2: Upload the export .zip here. If the .zip is not accepted, extract it and upload the two tracking-prod-records .csv files (plus followed_tv_show.csv and ratings-live-votes.csv for your watchlist and ratings) instead.

seo_title_default: Trakt Time: Track TV Shows & Movies
seo_description_default: Track the TV shows and movies you watch, never miss a new episode and find what to watch next. Coming from TV Time? Import your watch history in minutes.
compare_bingers_description: Compare Trakt Time and Bingers, two TV show and movie trackers for people coming from TV Time: platforms, price, TV Time import and more.
compare_bingers_intro: Trakt Time and Bingers are both TV show and movie trackers for people who used TV Time. Here is how they compare.
compare_bingers_maker_bingers: A team led by a TV Time co-founder
compare_bingers_platforms_trakt_time: In the browser on any device, installable on iPhone and Android
compare_bingers_history_trakt_time: Saved to your Trakt account and shared with other Trakt-connected apps
compare_bingers_faq_same_q: Is Trakt Time the same as Bingers?
compare_bingers_faq_same_a: No. Trakt Time is made by Trakt. Bingers is a separate app, and the two are not affiliated.
compare_bingers_faq_import_q: Can I bring my TV Time history to Trakt Time?
compare_bingers_faq_import_a: Yes. Sign in, open Settings and import your TV Time export from the TV Time Liberator extension or TV Time's GDPR data request.
compare_bingers_faq_both_q: Can I use Trakt Time and Bingers together?
compare_bingers_faq_both_a: Yes. They are independent, so you can import the same TV Time history into each and try both.
compare_bingers_disclaimer: Bingers is a trademark of its owner. Details about Bingers come from its App Store listing and press coverage and may change.
